metric_definitions.opened: PRs created in period (GitHub search, includes unmerged)
metric_definitions.flow_ratio: merged / opened in same calendar period
metric_definitions.unique_contributors: Distinct PR authors among merges in period
metric_definitions.review_p50_h: Median hours to first human review (excludes Copilot automated review)
metric_definitions.post_review_p50_h: Median hours from first human review to merge
metric_definitions.approval_to_merge_p50_h: Median hours from first human APPROVED review to merge
metric_definitions.slow_merge_pct_14d: Percent of merges with lead time over 14 days
metric_definitions.ci_fail_before_merge_pct: Percent with FAILURE on last 15 commits' check rollup (2025+ coverage)
metric_definitions.open_pr_history: Monthly snapshot points of open PR count and age percentiles
metric_definitions.review_excludes_automated: Copilot logins such as copilot-pull-request-reviewer are excluded
metric_definitions.files_p50: Median changed files per merged PR
metric_definitions.lines_p50: Median lines added+deleted per merged PR
metric_definitions.reviews_per_pr_p50: Median formal review submissions per merged PR
metric_definitions.comments_p50: Median issue-style PR comments (not review threads)
metric_definitions.revert_rate_pct: Share of merges whose title starts with Revert
metric_definitions.bot_merge_pct: Share of merges authored by *bot accounts
